block.name: Test suite fixes — #194 (Agent Zero asyncio) + #196 (QuantumGraph flaky tolerances)
acceptance_criteria: #194: agent-zero pytest.ini created with asyncio_mode = auto
#196: test_many_random_phases_average tolerance widened — test passes reliably
#196: test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude tolerance widened — test passes reliably
Both QuantumGraph flaky tests pass on 3 consecutive runs

never: Do NOT change any test logic — only widen tolerances or increase trial counts
Do NOT touch Morphogenesis, Praxis, or NeuroGraph files
anti_drift: Four targeted changes: two tolerance edits, one requirements line, one pytest.ini creation

steps.description: Confirm flaky tolerance expression exists before editing

params.command: python3 -c "p='/home/josh/QuantumGraph/quantumgraph/tests/test_amplitude.py'; s=open(p).read(); assert '< 0.5 * classical' in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace('< 0.5 * classical','< classical',1)); print('UPDATED')"

steps.description: #196 — Widen test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude abs tolerance from 0.03 to 0.05

params.command: python3 -c "p='/home/josh/QuantumGraph/quantumgraph/tests/test_collapse.py'; s=open(p).read(); assert 'abs=0.03' in s; open(p,'w').write(s.replace('pytest.approx(0.25, abs=0.03)','pytest.approx(0.25, abs=0.05)',1)); print('UPDATED')"

steps.description: Run the two previously-flaky tests three times to confirm stable

params.command: cd /home/josh/QuantumGraph && python3 -m pytest quantumgraph/tests/test_amplitude.py::TestMixedInterference::test_many_random_phases_average quantumgraph/tests/test_collapse.py::TestCollapseEdgeCases::test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && python3 -m pytest quantumgraph/tests/test_amplitude.py::TestMixedInterference::test_many_random_phases_average quantumgraph/tests/test_collapse.py::TestCollapseEdgeCases::test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && python3 -m pytest quantumgraph/tests/test_amplitude.py::TestMixedInterference::test_many_random_phases_average quantumgraph/tests/test_collapse.py::TestCollapseEdgeCases::test_complex_amplitudes_same_magnitude -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && echo 'ALL 3 RUNS PASSED'

steps.description: pytest-asyncio in agent-zero requirements.txt, pytest.ini with asyncio_mode=auto created, both QuantumGraph tolerance tests pass 3 consecutive runs.
